readme.markdown: # AgentiScript **The visual language of the agentic economy.** 3,790 emoji exist. Zero represent the agentic economy. AgentiScript fills that gap. Every concept the agentic economy speaks but cannot show gets a visual token. ## What is in here - `/icons/` SVG icons + JSON metadata for every concept - `agentiscript.json` machine-readable index of all icons ## Use it ```html ``` ```bash npm install agentiscript ``` ## License Free tier: CC0 — do whatever you want. Pro tier: Commercial license at agentiscript.com/store ## Contributing See something missing? Submit at agentiscript.com/submit --- *The language grows every day. So does the economy it speaks for.*
